headline: EVERSOURCE petition to install a 35-foot pole on Lansing Place to power 109-113 Oakland Street apartments after a fire.
summary: The only item is one petition from EVERSOURCE. The pole would stand about 20 feet north of the driveway curb and 25 feet west of the curb line.
items: Install one fully owned 35-foot CL1 pole on Lansing Place, about 20 feet north of the driveway curb and 25 feet west of the curb line
Pole would upgrade and provide power to 109-113 Oakland Street Apartments after fire
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 11/18/2026 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can be acted 
upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
121 Oakland Street 
 
Petitions 
To install one (1) fully owned 35’ CL1 Pole. The pole is to be located approximately 20’ North 
of the driveway curb 25’ West of the curb line on Lansing Place. This pole will be used to 
upgrade and provide power to 109-113 Oakland Street Apartments post fire 
 1. EVERSOURCE - 113 Oakland Street
